text:
alex: Quick check — eu-west1 A100 dedicated pool shows 0 available for burst right now, anyone else seeing that?
vendor-bot: FYI vendor allocation inbound: rack ETA tomorrow 08:00 UTC, but not guaranteed for dedicated reservations.
maya: Confirmed in console, capacity 0. I opened INC-7821 with vendor support, link: https://vendor.example.com/t/INC-7821
chen: For the 15:00 canary loadtest we need ~4 A100s for ~2h. If dedicated isn't possible, can we fallback to h100 in eu-west2?
luis: eu-west2 H100 has ~20 slots but higher p99 latency for our model (~25% worse) and cost ~+30%. Might be fine for canary if we mark it as degraded.
alex: If we go H100 we should gate outputs and flag in the dashboard. Also prefer borrowing from demo pool if available to keep latency consistent.
maya: Demo pool currently shows 2 free A100s. I'll request a soft borrow, pinging @platform-allocs.
platform-allocs: request received — running allocation checks and billing softquota.
platform-allocs: blocked by billing softquota for cross-tenant borrow, need manual finance approval to allow temporary chargeback.
finance: @platform-allocs approved 4-slot soft-borrow for 2h as a one-off (chargeback ok). Please tag charge code INF-CLD.
platform-allocs: Reservation created: demo->project-redwood, 4 A100s, window 14:45–16:45 UTC. Please confirm smoke test times.
alex: Confirmed, we'll start canary at 15:00 UTC and run perf + correctness suites.
luis: Heads-up — H100 fallback plan still in place (if borrow fails). Add perf monitor: run `./scripts/monitor_perf --targets=canary,staging --window=30m`
chen: I'll drop a tiny smoke script that hits the endpoint 100x and validates latency/p95: 
```bash
for i in {1..100}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' >/dev/null; done
```
maya: Thanks — I'll also add a dashboard note and set an alert for p95 > 700ms for the canary route.
alex: Perfect. Once canary finishes, post results here and we can close the borrow. :thumbsup: 
platform-allocs: Noted — will auto-release if not extended.
alex: Closing loop — will report back with canary outcome ~16:30 UTC.
